1.1: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
1.2: Grace and peace to y'all from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.3: We gotta thank God all the time for you, brothers and sisters, 'cause it's the right thing to do. Your faith is growing like crazy, and the love y'all have for each other is overflowing.
1.4: We brag on y'all to the other churches of God for your patience and faith through all the stuff you've been going through—your persecutions and struggles.
1.5: All of this shows that God's judgment is right, and it proves that you're worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you're suffering.
1.6: God's gonna handle business and repay with trouble those who are giving you trouble.
1.7: And for you who are troubled, you'll get rest with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with His mighty angels.
1.8: He's coming in flaming fire, taking vengeance on those who don't know God and on those who don't follow the gospel of our Lord Jesus.
1.9: They gonna be punished with everlasting destruction—separated from God's presence and glory.
1.10: When He comes back, He's gonna be glorified in His saints, and all those who believed in Him will admire Him, 'cause the testimony we gave you was real and y'all believed it.
1.11: That's why we're always praying for y'all, asking God to make you worthy of this calling and to fulfill all the good stuff He's planned for you.
1.12: We want Jesus' name to be glorified in you, and for you to be glorified in Him, all because of the grace of God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

2.1: So, brothers and sisters, about the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and us getting gathered together to Him, we're asking you,
2.2: Don't let anyone shake you up or get you all worried—whether by spirit, word, or letter, like it's from us, saying that the day of Christ has already come.
2.3: Don't let nobody trick you. That day ain't coming unless there's a falling away first, and the man of sin is revealed—the son of destruction,
2.4: Who opposes everything that's called God, or anything that's worshiped, so much so that he sits in the temple of God, showing himself as God.
2.5: Don't y'all remember when I was with you, I told you all this?
2.6: And now you know what's holding him back, so he can be revealed when it's time.
2.7: The mystery of lawlessness is already in motion, but only He who is holding it back will continue to do so until He's outta the way.
2.8: Then the lawless one will be revealed, and the Lord will take him out with the breath of His mouth and destroy him with the brightness of His coming.
2.9: The coming of this lawless one will be powered by Satan, with all kinds of power, signs, and fake miracles,
2.10: And with all kinds of lies and deception to trick those who are perishing, 'cause they didn't receive the love of the truth that would've saved them.
2.11: So, God's gon' send them a strong delusion, and they'll believe the lie,
2.12: So that everyone who didn't believe the truth but enjoyed doing wrong, will be condemned.
2.13: But we gotta thank God always for you, brothers and sisters loved by the Lord, 'cause God chose you from the beginning to be saved through the Holy Spirit's work and belief in the truth,
2.14: And He called you by our gospel, so you could obtain the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
2.15: So, brothers and sisters, stand firm and hold tight to the teachings you received, whether through our preaching or by our letter.
2.16: Now, may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself, and our God and Father, who loved us and gave us everlasting comfort and good hope through grace,
2.17: Comfort your hearts and keep you solid in every good word and work.

3.1: Alright, brothers and sisters, pray for us, that the word of the Lord can spread fast and be glorified, just like it's been with you,
3.2: And that we may be delivered from those unreasonable and wicked people, 'cause not everyone's got faith.
3.3: But the Lord is faithful, and He's gonna set you up and protect you from the evil one.
3.4: We confident in the Lord about you, that you're doing and will keep doing the things we've told you to do.
3.5: Now may the Lord guide your hearts into God's love and into Christ's patience.
3.6: But we're telling you straight up, in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ: Stay away from any brother who's walking disorderly, not following the tradition we showed you.
3.7: You already know how you should follow us—we didn't slack off when we were with you;
3.8: We didn't just take food from people for free—we worked hard, night and day, so we wouldn't be a burden to any of you.
3.9: Not because we didn't have the right to, but we wanted to show y'all how to live and be examples to follow.
3.10: Even when we were with you, we told you: If someone don't work, they don't eat.
3.11: We're hearing that some of y'all aren't working, but instead are out here being busybodies.
3.12: So for those people, we're telling them in Jesus' name: get to work quietly, and eat your own food.
3.13: But as for you, brothers and sisters, don't get tired of doing what's right.
3.14: If someone don't obey what we've written in this letter, mark that person and don't hang with them, so they can be ashamed.
3.15: But don't treat them like an enemy—admonish them like a brother.
3.16: Now may the Lord of peace Himself give you peace all the time, in every way. The Lord be with y'all.
3.17: This greeting is from Paul, written with my own hand, that's my signature in every letter.
3.18: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with y'all. Amen.
